channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK backs Syria pledge to eliminate chemical weapons
item.description: The UK has welcomed commitments by Syria’s new leadership to fully identify and eliminate remaining chemical weapons stockpiles, according to a statement delivered at the UN Security Council. The post UK backs Syria pledge to eliminate chemical weapons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: FCDO moves ahead with Berlin embassy security renewal
item.description: The UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) has launched preliminary market engagement for a new contract to renew security guarding services at the British Embassy in Berlin The post FCDO moves ahead with Berlin embassy security renewal first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. Navy to use AI to speed up shipbuilding
item.description: The U.S. Navy has committed $448 million to accelerate the use of artificial intelligence and autonomy across the shipbuilding sector. The post U.S. Navy to use AI to speed up shipbuilding first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Mk44S Bushmaster enters full-rate production
item.description: Northrop Grumman has entered full-rate production of its Mk44 Stretch Bushmaster Chain Gun for the U.S. Marine Corps’ Amphibious Combat Vehicle programme, with the weapon set to equip the ACV-30. The post Mk44S Bushmaster enters full-rate production first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Lithuania orders RBS 70 Bolide missiles from Saab
item.description: Saab has received an order for RBS 70 Bolide short-range air defence missiles from the Lithuanian Ministry of National Defence, with deliveries planned between 2028 and 2032, according to the company. The post Lithuania orders RBS 70 Bolide missiles from Saab first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: US Air Force designates Talon prototype as YFQ-48A
item.description: The US Air Force has assigned the designation YFQ-48A to Northrop Grumman’s Project Talon prototype, marking its formal entry into the service’s Collaborative Combat Aircraft programme. The post US Air Force designates Talon prototype as YFQ-48A first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: U.S. carrier in live fire drill to deter China aggression
item.description: Aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln has carried out live-fire exercises in the South China Sea as part of routine operations by the carrier strike group in the Indo-Pacific, according to the U.S. Navy. The post U.S. carrier in live fire drill to deter China aggression first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Britain is building a ballistic missile for Ukraine
item.description: The Nightfall ballistic missile programme, first disclosed last year, has now been formally confirmed as a UK-led effort intended for Ukrainian use while also informing future British long-range strike capabilities. The post Britain is building a ballistic missile for Ukraine first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Iranian-linked Scottish accounts fall silent again
item.description: A network of social media accounts posing as Scottish independence supporters has fallen silent once again, closely mirroring a fresh shutdown of internet access inside Iran. The post Iranian-linked Scottish accounts fall silent again first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Faslane nuclear base tugboats may be built in China
item.description: Tugboats intended to support operations at the UK’s nuclear submarine base at Faslane may be built in China under a major base services replacement programme. The post Faslane nuclear base tugboats may be built in China first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
